name: The Farm 1780
tagline: Authentic Pumpkin Patch in Lexington SC
description: The Farm 1780 is a independent farm in Lexington, SC. It grows Blueberries, Blackberries, Flowers, and Sunflowers, with seasonal availability through summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
